Dear Tripura,

Happy 25th Birthday, you wonderful human! 💗

Twenty-five years of you being you, and honestly, the world has been a little more beautiful because of it.

As you step into this new chapter, I hope you never forget how incredibly special you are. You're chasing a dream that takes so much courage, dedication, patience, and heart. One day, that dream of becoming a doctor will have your name attached to it, and I genuinely cannot wait for the world to meet Dr. Tripura.

I hope life gives you a million reasons to smile. I hope you find magic in the little things, strength on the difficult days, and happiness in places you never expected.

Never let the world make you forget the beautiful person you are.

Keep being your goofy, wonderful, slightly chaotic, honey-loving self.

And remember, even Pooh knows that sometimes the best thing to do is simply eat cake and enjoy the moment.

Here's to 25, to big dreams, little adventures, endless laughter, and a lifetime of happiness.

You deserve all the love in the world.
